sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Flow cytometry confirmed cell-surface display of the His-tagged full-length LVRN protein; no enzymatic or binding functional assay reported in the clip.
sites.rationale: LVRN is a type II single-pass TM protein (intracellular 1–13, TM 14–36, extracellular 37–990). The N-terminus is cytoplasmic and cannot carry a surface-accessible tag; the C-terminus at residue 990 is the sole extracellular terminus, 954 residues from the TM boundary. The '-His' suffix convention and the flow-cytometric surface confirmation together place the tag at the C-terminus. Python confirmed residue 990 = T and residue 989 = N. PMC10495628 reports a full-length hLVRN-His construct expressed in Swan71 human trophoblast cells; surface display of the His-tagged protein was confirmed by flow cytometric analysis. No specific residue is named in the clip.

sources.claim: The cell surface expression of LVRN in Swan71_LVRN was also confirmed by the flow cytometric analysis ( Figure 1 B).

literature_notes: L1 is the only ledger line. It names no specific residue; the C-terminal position is derived from the type II topology (single extracellular terminus). The clip reports surface display by flow cytometry but no enzymatic activity, ligand-binding, or trafficking assay, so validation_level is surface_only. No internal loop insertions are supported by the ledger.
